posts.trend: UPI MDR For Capital Markets: Why A Tiny Fee Could Test India’s Zero-brokerage Model
posts.context: Every micro-convenience that defined the early digital experiences of young urban Indians is slowly being monetized.
posts.angle: Adulthood in India is a series of tiny, unavoidable tolls where 'free forever' was actually just a trial period.
slides: Open any financial app on your phone right now.

Step 1: Download because it is "free forever".

Step 2: Accumulate ₹14 in platform fees.

Step 3: Pay GST on the fee.

Step 4: Pay GST on the tax on the fee.

The convenience is no longer convenient.

The app always gets its rupee.
posts.caption: The price of doing business is you. 💸
posts.rank_verdict: The landing moralises and explains the joke instead of staying deadpan.
